slideshow.title: Opening the Books
slideshow.description: Eight slides on October 14–27, 2026: Anthropic's S-1 revenue, compute costs and customers, GPT-6.1 Terra, Genie 4, Apple's AI hardware, and what Nvidia and SpaceX earn from AI compute.

slides.title: Opening the Books: fourteen days of AI, October 14–27, 2026
Anthropic's quarterly revenue grew from $376M to $11.6B in five quarters
Anthropic's compute cost fell from 251% to 48% of revenue; first operating profit of $974M
Anthropic customers: 11,900+ spending $100K, about 900% net revenue retention, $6.6M revenue per employee
GPT-6.1 Terra: $1 / $5 per million tokens, 50.3% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, over 3x faster than Sol
Genie 4 adds sound and live text steering to real-time simulated worlds
Apple: iMac M6 up to 5x faster on-device AI vs the M4 iMac; iPad mini 4.5x AI vs the previous iPad mini; Apple TV 4K 2x GPU vs the previous model
Nvidia earns about $40B per gigawatt with Rubin; SpaceX's AI segment grew 830%
